# appzones: the complete guide

> Long-lived sandboxes for desktop apps, dev tools and AI agents on Linux (NixOS). This file is every guide page of {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/ in reading order, as Markdown. Source: https://github.com/mirql/appzones (MIT). Each page starts with a line `Source: docs/PATH`; its relative links are rewritten to full raw URLs.
